Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Alma Vasquez | DOB: 06/13/1974 | MRN: SYN-4718162
Date of service: 03/24/2025 | Dr. Marek Cordero, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
50-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2020, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: gastroesophageal reflux, hypothyroidism.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
She has taken weekly methotrexate (20 mg) for the better part of nine months, yet the small joints of both hands remain swollen.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 34.
Latent TB blood test and hepatitis B panel drawn on 02/02/2025 both came back clear.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
